title: Radio: Distribution 2 — closing the outlet valve

fields.orgName: City of Millbrook Department of Water & Sewer

lines.text: Control, Distribution 2 at Orchard. Police will walk one of us into the valve vault. The outlet valve is a 12-inch gate valve, about sixty turns, so twenty minutes.
Confirm the wells are off before we start, or we’ll overflow the standpipe onto their crime scene.

fields.voiceStyle: Man in his 40s, practical, truck idling

instructorNote: Watch for the wells confirmed off on RTU-06 before the valve is closed.

snapshot.title: Orchard Standpipe Isolation — Pressure Stability Confirmed

fields.orgName: City of Millbrook Department of Water & Sewer

lines.text: Control, this is Distribution Lead, Tom Okonkwo. I’ve just confirmed with PIT-501 on the Zone 2 pressure trend. It’s at 24.3 psi and stable. No drop below 20 psi. No customers report loss of pressure. We can isolate Orchard Standpipe via IC-2 without affecting service. Recommend proceeding with isolation per ERP Section 7.1.

fields.voiceStyle: Middle-aged male, calm but urgent, slight pause after 'stable'

snapshot.instructorNote: This inject confirms operational feasibility of isolation. Watch for the IC to validate the go-ahead based on ERP Section 7.1 and the absence of pressure impact.
